motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council declare the City-owned fee interest beneath Industrial Street between Central Avenue and Alameda Street to be surplus property in accordance with Article 7 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council direct the Department of General Services, with the assistance of the Bureau of Engineering and the City Attorney, to take all necessary steps to process this surplus declaration consistent with applicable City procedures.
